title: "Water Excess Forces Cut in Gemini's Power" – Washington Post, Aug. 26, 1965, p. A11
description: Washington Post clipping (page A11) reporting that excess water from the fuel cells forced a cut in Gemini 5 power use, datelined Houston, Aug. 25. A sidebar headed "Round-by-Round Story Of Gemini 5 Flight" gives a chronological log by orbit (56th–64th orbits), including entries on the crew spotting a Minuteman missile launch. Subheads include "New Space Record" and "Fuel Cell Problem"; a fragment of a restaurant advertisement appears at the upper right edge.
